on course to

(preposition). Đang trên đà, đang có khả năng

The project is on course to be completed ahead of schedule.

repercussion

(noun). Hậu quả, ảnh hưởng

The trade war had serious repercussions for the global economy.

within the normal range

(adjective). Trong phạm vi bình thường

After the tests, the patient's blood pressure was confirmed to be within the normal range.

exceptional

(adjective). Phi thường, đặc biệt

The young musician showed exceptional talent from an early age.

milder

(adjective). Dịu hơn, nhẹ hơn

The doctor recommended a milder form of exercise after his injury.

high-altitude ski resort

(noun). Khu nghỉ dưỡng trượt tuyết trên cao

We spent our winter holiday at a high-altitude ski resort in the Alps.

heatwave

(noun). Đợt nắng nóng

The region is bracing for a severe heatwave this week, with temperatures expected to exceed $40^\circ\text{C}$.

sections.title: Passage 3: Amateur Naturalists
sections.html:
wealth

(noun). sự phong phú, sự dồi dào

Ex: She has a wealth of teaching experience.

unearth

(verb). phát hiện, đưa ra ánh sáng

Ex: The newspaper has unearthed some disturbing facts.

uncover

(verb). khám phá

Ex: It will be difficult to uncover the truth.

trivial

(adjective). nhỏ nhặt, tầm thường

Ex: I know it sounds trivial, but I'm worried about it.

tip somebody off

(verb). cho biết, báo tin

Ex: He tipped police off on his car phone about a suspect drunk driver.

spread

(verb). Dàn trải, lan toả

Ex: The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.

rigorous

(adjective). Tỉ mỉ, kĩ càng

Ex: The second team adopted a much more rigorous approach to the problem.

reveal

(verb). Tiết lộ

Ex: The survey reveals some worrying statistics.

response

(noun). câu trả lời, phản hồi

Ex: We have asked for a meeting and we are awaiting a response.

overwhelming

(adjective). tràn ngập, làm choáng ngợp

Ex: There was overwhelming support for our policies.

odd

(adjective). Kì lạ

Ex: It seems odd that nobody noticed anything wrong.

migratory

(adjective). Có tập tính di cư

Ex: Sea eagles are not migratory, so once extinct, there is no chance of them returning naturally.

journal

(noun). tập san

Ex: a medical journal

idiosyncrasy

(noun). đặc tính riêng, cách biểu hiện riêng

Ex: She often cracks her knuckles when she's speaking - it's one of her little idiosyncrasies.

guide

(verb). hướng dẫn

Ex: Our lawyer guided us through the more complicated questions on the form.

gauge

(verb). đánh giá, phán đoán

Ex: It's difficult to gauge how they'll react.

frightening

(adjective). đáng sợ

Ex: a truly frightening horror movie Ex: It was all very frightening to a small boy.

equally

(adverb). bằng nhau

Ex: Diet and exercise are equally important.

disregard

(verb). không quan tâm đến

Ex: He totally disregarded all the advice he was given.

devotion

(noun). Sự cống hiến

Ex: His devotion to his wife and family is touching.

conservation

(noun). Sự bảo tồn

Ex: Road development in the area has been severely affected by the conservation programmes of the council.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

Ex: Several factors had combined to ruin our plans.

arrival

(noun). sự đến, sự xuất hiện

Ex: The arrival of satellite television changed the face of broadcasting.

archive

(noun). Kho lưu trữ

Ex: I've been studying village records in the local archive.

annual

(adjective). hàng năm

Ex: The 12th annual Music Festival runs from Friday 25th to Monday 28th October.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

acknowledge

(verb). Công nhận

Ex: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.

prove

(verb). Chứng minh

Ex: She was determined to prove everyone wrong.

phenology

(noun). vật hậu học

Ex: Other investigations suggest a fundamental role for plant phenology in the population dynamics of oak herbivores.

invaluable

(adjective). Vô giá

Ex: The books will be invaluable for students in higher education.

ecologist

(noun). Nhà sinh thái học

Ex: This course is for anyone wanting to become a professional ecologist.

retiring

(adjective). kín đáo

Ex: Those of a shy and retiring nature are not suited to this kind of activity.

colleague

(noun). Đồng nghiệp

Ex: We were friends and colleagues for more than 20 years.

aware

(adjective). Có nhận thức

Ex: They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.

amateur

(adjective). nghiệp dư

Ex: He believes the archaeological trust has a major educational role to play - for professional and amateur archaeologists alike.

record

(noun). ghi chép

Ex: You should keep a record of your expenses.

thrilled

(adjective). hồi hộp

Ex: I'm really thrilled with the results.

scientific

(adjective). thuộc về khoa học

Ex: The book lacks any sound scientific basis.

react

(verb). phản ứng

Ex: Local residents have reacted angrily to the news.

involvement

(noun). sự liên quan, sự tham gia

Ex: He encourages parental involvement in the running of school.

empower

(verb). truyền sức mạnh, làm cho có khả năng

Ex: The movement actively empowered women and gave them confidence in themselves.

scheme

(noun). Kế hoạch

Ex: Under the new scheme only successful schools will be given extra funding.

geographical

(adjective). Về mặt địa lý

Ex: The survey covers a wide geographical area.

evident

(adjective). Hiển nhiên

Ex: It has now become evident to us that a mistake has been made.

enthusiasm

(noun). sự hào hứng, sự hăng hái

Ex: The news was greeted with a lack of enthusiasm by those at the meeting.

enlist

(verb). kêu gọi, tranh thủ (cảm tình, sự cộng tác,...

Ex: They hoped to enlist the help of the public in solving the crime.

encourage

(verb). khuyến khích

Ex: My parents have always encouraged me in my choice of career.

effort

(noun). sự cố gắng

Ex: The local clubs are making every effort to interest more young people.

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

Ex: a significant contribution to scientific knowledge Ex: He made a very positive contribution to the success of the project.

breadth

(noun). sự sâu rộng

Ex: He was surprised at her breadth of reading.

observer

(noun). người quan sát

Ex: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.

migration

(noun). Di cư

Ex: Scientists track bird populations and migration patterns.

hint

(verb). gợi ý, ám chỉ

Ex: The papers also hinted that the problem was really his private life.

hibernation

(noun). sự ngủ đông

Ex: Frogs in deep hibernation take longer to emerge to answer the call of the spring mating season.

hemisphere

(noun). Bán cầu

Ex: Countries in both the Northern and Southern hemispheres continue to treat the world's rivers, seas and oceans as dumping grounds.

emergence

(noun). sự nổi lên, sự xuất hiện

Ex: China's emergence as an economic power

compare

(verb). so sánh

Ex: We compared the two reports carefully.

prediction

(noun). Dự đoán

Ex: It's difficult to make accurate predictions about the effects on the environment.

erect

(verb). dựng lên

Ex: Police had to erect barriers to keep crowds back.

contest

(noun). cuộc thi

Ex: She was awarded the first prize in an essay contest .

clue

(noun). manh mối, gợi ý

Ex: They are searching for clues about the kidnapping.

attempt

(verb). cố gắng, nỗ lực

Ex: I will attempt to answer all your questions.

naturalist

(noun). nhà tự nhiên học

Ex: Some nineteenth-century naturalists denied that animals possessed any mental qualities besides instincts.’

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

compile

(verb). tập hợp, lắp ráp

Ex: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.

estate

(noun). Bất động sản

Ex: The poet's childhood was spent on a country estate.

largely

(adverb). phần lớn

Ex: The manager was largely responsible for the team’s victory.

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng, bao gồm

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

record

(verb). ghi chép, ghi nhận

Ex: Unemployment is likely to reach the highest total that has ever been recorded.

famous

(adjective). nổi tiếng

Ex: Loch Ness is probably the most famous lake in Scotland.

cycle

(noun). chu kỳ

Ex: They could not break the cycle of harvest failure, food shortage, price increase and misery.

significantly

(adverb). 1 cách đáng kể

Ex: Profits have increased significantly over the past few years.

due to

(phrase). vì

Ex: A lot of her unhappiness is due to boredom.

breeding

(noun). sự sinh sản

Ex: They do not have complete knowledge of breeding and rearing young parrots.

analysis

(noun). phân tích

Ex: Further analysis revealed significant regional variations in the results.

reliable

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

Ex: Our information comes from a reliable source.

precisely

(adverb). Chính xác, rõ ràng

Ex: They look precisely the same to me.

interaction

(noun). sự tương tác

Ex: There's not enough interaction between the management and the workers.

discredit

(verb). bác bỏ

Ex: These theories are now largely discredited among linguists.

constitute

(verb). Cấu tạo nên

Ex: Female workers constitute the majority of the labour force.

concern

(noun). mối lo ngại, mối quan tâm

Ex: Villagers expressed concern about the level of traffic.

candidate

(noun). ứng cử viên

Ex: He is the best candidate for the job.

unsystematic

(adjective). không hệ thống

Ex: Training for volunteers is patchy and unsystematic.

subjective

(adjective). Chủ quan

Ex: Everyone's opinion is bound to be subjective.

precise

(adjective). Chính xác

Ex: Can you give a more precise definition of the word?

onset

(noun). sự bắt đầu

Ex: The new treatment can delay the onset of the disease by several years.

illustrate

(verb). Minh hoạ

Ex: He is showing these silent films to help illustrate his story of survival.

uncertainty

(noun). Sự không chắc chắn, thiếu rõ ràng

Ex: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.

technique

(noun). Kĩ thuật

Ex: Researchers used advanced techniques to analyse the brain scans.

statistical

(adjective). thuộc về mặt thống kê

Ex: He lectured and assisted with tutorial sessions and began to take an interest in statistical ideas.

observation

(noun). sự quan sát

Ex: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.

method

(noun). Phương pháp

Ex: Which method is the most effective?

warn

(verb). cảnh báo

Ex: Security experts warned about the problems months ago.

potentially

(adverb). có triển vọng

Ex: This crisis is potentially the most serious in the organization's history.

infestation

(noun). sự đầy rẫy

Ex: Scientists are checking for both insect and fungal infestation.

awareness

(noun). Nhận thức

Ex: Politicians now have much greater awareness of these problems.
